text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service `inference-runtime-prod` (INC12345) -> routed to schedule `prod-support` (rule id: 0x5f3b). Severity: P1. Payload: high error rate from inference workers in us-west-2.

maya: saw the page, looks like it went to Customer Success oncall instead of SRE eng. anyone else see that?

ben (oncall): I got the PD notification but i'm not in the SRE rota today. i acknowledged because it said urgent, but i'm not the right responder. :confused:

dave-support: yeah CS team got multiple PD calls. they were like "we don't own inference-runtime-prod" and escalated back. pinging @eve-sre — can you confirm routing?

eve-sre: on it. checking `pd-service-tags` and schedule bindings now. hold for trace.

pd-sync-bot: pd-sync job 2024-11-12T03:21:05Z: applied changes from `infra/pagerduty.tf` (author: @infra-bot).

maya: wonder if the recent terraform PR accidentally changed the support_team or tags. we rolled that PR last night.

eve-sre: quick grep on repo: `git log -p -- infra/pagerduty.tf | sed -n '1,120p'` shows this diff:```diff
-resource "pagerduty_service" "inference_runtime" {
-  name        = "inference-runtime-prod"
-  support_team = "sre"
+resource "pagerduty_service" "inference_runtime" {
+  name        = "inference-runtime-prod"
+  support_team = "cs"
 }
```
Looks like support_team flipped to cs. pd-sync bot then applied the change.

ben (oncall): ouch. who approved that PR?

maya: PR #6182 by @infra-bot auto-merged via repo rule — it was meant to add a new support tag for a different service but the selector matched inference-runtime by mistake.

dave-support: CS handled the first triage but then paged us back. we lost ~9 minutes on initial ack/handback. customers saw elevated error rate for a short window.

eve-sre: mitigation plan: 1) reassign INC12345 to SRE primary 2) revert support_team tag on PD service 3) add a safety rule in pd-sync to prevent broad selectors. executing now.

eve-sre: running PD CLI to reassign:```bash
pd incidents assign INC12345 --responder_ids "U12345" --note "reassigning to SRE; wrong support_team tag caused misroute"
```

pd-sync-bot: incident INC12345 reassigned to user U12345 (eve-sre).

ben (oncall): confirmed receipt. i'm taking ownership and starting mitigation steps on the cluster.

maya: recorded customer impact: ~350 requests failed between 03:21:05Z and 03:30:00Z (brief spike). not a customer-wide outage but visible for a subset of traffic hitting worker pool A.

eve-sre: rolling a hotfix rollback for `infra/pagerduty.tf` to restore support_team -> `sre`. applying via ks-apply.```bash
git revert --no-edit 6182 && git push origin main && pd-sync run --apply
```

pd-sync-bot: pd-sync run scheduled; will apply in 30s.

pd-sync-bot: pd-sync job completed: `inference-runtime-prod` support_team restored to `sre`.

maya: can we add a check so PRs that touch `pagerduty.tf` must have an explicit whitelist of affected services?

eve-sre: yes. immediate next actions: 1) create a short branch with a linter that enforces explicit service list for pd resources 2) add a staging PD sync run that requires manual approval 3) open postmortem ticket with timeline.

dave-support: CS will update customer messages — we told them it was a routing hiccup and mitigation is done.

ben (oncall): mitigation complete. rolling restart on worker pool A to clear any bad state. monitoring looks good.

maya: filing followup ticket: https://tickets.company/INC12345-rtl (brief writeup + timeline). tagging for postmortem: #postmortem.

eve-sre: short blameless postmortem notes in thread: cause = terraform selector mis-match -> pd-sync applied wrong support_team -> pages routed to CS -> delayed correct owner ack -> ~9m elevated errors. action items: add mandatory explicit service field in pagerduty terraform module, require manual PD-sync approval for PD service changes, add PD runbook link to inference runtime runbook.

dave-support: thanks all. can we also add an automatic PD annotation when pd-sync applies changes that touch `support_team` so pagers see recent config changes? would help on-call figure out routing oddities faster.

eve-sre: agreed. adding to action list.

maya: closing thread — incident resolved, followups tracked in ticket. :thumbsup:
